en.summary: A managed service to create and control the keys that encrypt and sign your data. KMS keys are protected by validated hardware security modules and never leave the service unencrypted.
examCues: Encrypt data at rest in AWS services with keys you control → Key Management Service
Rotate an encryption key automatically on a schedule → Key Management Service (customer managed key)
Decide exactly which users and roles may use a key → Key Management Service (key policy)

notToConfuseWith.difference: CloudHSM gives you HSMs in the AWS Cloud over which you have complete control; KMS is a managed service that you call to use and manage keys.
Secrets Manager stores and rotates secrets such as database credentials and API keys; KMS manages encryption keys.

en.pricingModel: Customer managed keys have a monthly fee per key plus a fee per use. AWS managed keys have no monthly fee but API use is charged, and AWS owned keys have no charges.

aws: Protects keys in hardware security modules and never exposes them unencrypted
Rotates the key material of AWS managed keys every year
customer: Writes key policies that decide who can use and manage each key
Turns on rotation for customer managed keys when needed
Chooses whether each service uses an AWS owned, AWS managed or customer managed key

es.summary: Un servicio administrado para crear y controlar las llaves que cifran y firman tus datos. Las KMS keys están protegidas por hardware security modules validados y nunca salen del servicio sin cifrar.
examCues: Cifrar datos en reposo en servicios de AWS con llaves que tú controlas → Key Management Service
Rotar una llave de cifrado de forma automática con un calendario → Key Management Service (customer managed key)
Decidir con exactitud qué usuarios y roles pueden usar una llave → Key Management Service (key policy)

notToConfuseWith.difference: CloudHSM te da HSMs en la nube de AWS sobre los que tienes control total; KMS es un servicio administrado al que llamas para usar y administrar llaves.
Secrets Manager guarda y rota secretos como credenciales de bases de datos y API keys; KMS administra llaves de cifrado.

es.pricingModel: Las customer managed keys tienen una tarifa mensual por llave más un cargo por uso. Las AWS managed keys no tienen tarifa mensual pero se cobra el uso de la API, y las AWS owned keys no tienen cargos.

aws: Protege las llaves en hardware security modules y nunca las expone sin cifrar
Rota cada año el material de las AWS managed keys
customer: Escribe las key policies que deciden quién puede usar y administrar cada llave
Activa la rotación de las customer managed keys cuando hace falta
Elige si cada servicio usa una AWS owned key, una AWS managed key o una customer managed key
